item.title: Global Meet-Up #1 (Tokyo): Japan's Geo-Political Outlook
item.description:
On Tuesday, July 14, 2026, Professor Jiang visited Tokyo, and discussed Japan's geo-political outlook. What follows are highlights from the 3-hour event.
Much appreciation to Keito Ochi for organizing the event at Lakeland University.
